# Wavetile

> Wavetile is a Jellyfin music player for iPhone (iOS 26.1+) with a full podcast player built in: your Jellyfin music and your podcasts in one app. It streams and downloads music from your own Jellyfin server, with gapless playback, offline downloads, Instant Mix radio and widgets. No account, no analytics, no tracking. Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/wavetile-music/id6826722664.

## How it's different from other Jellyfin apps
- A full podcast player built in: directory search, follow by URL, OPML import, chapters, transcripts, downloads, subscriptions synced through Jellyfin
- A local copy of the library on the device, so browsing is instant and works offline, even with 50,000 tracks

## Compared with other Jellyfin music apps
Finamp, Jellify and Manet are other good Jellyfin music clients for iPhone. Choose Wavetile for podcasts in the same app as your music, a local library that is instant and works offline, and an app that collects nothing. Details: https://wavetile.com/why-wavetile

## Who it's for
- People who host their music on a Jellyfin server and want a native iPhone app for it
- Self-hosters and homelab users moving off Spotify or Apple Music to their own library
- Listeners with large libraries (tested with 50,000 tracks) or lossless FLAC collections

## Features
- Sign in with a server address or Jellyfin Quick Connect; token stored in the iOS Keychain
- Full library sync to the device: instant browsing, search and sorting, even offline
- Home feed: Recently Played, Most Played, Latest Podcast Episodes (if podcasts are on), Playlists & Collections, Recently Added, Artist Spotlight
- Gapless playback, shuffle, repeat, sleep timer, AirPlay, Lock Screen and Control Center controls
- Start Radio: Jellyfin Instant Mix from any song, album or artist
- Background downloads of albums and playlists as 256 kbps MP3 or the original file (e.g. FLAC), with a Live Activity
- Podcasts (optional): directory search, follow by URL, OPML import, chapters, transcripts, episode downloads, subscriptions synced through Jellyfin
- Now Playing and Recently Played widgets, Siri, Dark and Light themes
- CarPlay

## Requirements and limits
- iPhone with iOS 26.1 or later (iPhone only)
- A Jellyfin server with a music library
- Plain http works only on a home network; servers reachable from the internet need https

## FAQ
- Is it free? Yes, free on the App Store.
- Does it work offline? Yes: the library is copied to the device, and downloaded albums, playlists and episodes play with no connection.
- Can I download FLAC? Yes: downloads are 256 kbps MP3 or the original file, such as FLAC.
- Are podcasts required? No, they are off by default (Settings → Show Podcasts).
- Does it collect data? No account, no analytics, no tracking.
